description: This file contains JavaScript code for customizing and extending CKEDITOR toolbar behavior, including plugin addition, toolbar configuration, and DOM manipulation.

classes.name: ToolbarConfigurator.AbstractToolbarModifier
classes.description: Abstract class for modifying CKEDITOR toolbars, managing configuration, editor instance, and UI elements.

classes.name: ToolbarConfigurator.FullToolbarEditor
classes.description: Class responsible for managing full toolbar editing features, including button creation and UI management.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets the toolbar configuration and initializes the toolbar modifier.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the toolbar modifier with a given configuration.

methods.name: _onInit
methods.description: Handles initialization logic with optional configuration string.

methods.name: _createModifier
methods.description: Creates and appends the main container for the toolbar modifier.

methods.name: getEditableArea
methods.description: Returns the editable area DOM element.

methods.name: _hideEditable
methods.description: Hides the editable area by setting height to zero.

methods.name: _showEditable
methods.description: Shows the editable area by restoring its height.

methods.name: _toggleEditable
methods.description: Toggles visibility of the editable area.

methods.name: _refreshEditor
methods.description: Recreates the editor instance to refresh configuration.

methods.name: _createEditor
methods.description: Creates a CKEDITOR instance with optional configuration.

methods.name: _createToolbar
methods.description: Creates the toolbar DOM elements based on configured buttons.

methods.name: _createToolbarBtn
methods.description: Creates a toolbar button element with callback.

methods.name: _fixGroups
methods.description: Fixes and adds toolbar groups based on configuration.

methods.name: stringifyJSONintoOneLine
methods.description: Serializes JSON object into a single-line string with optional formatting.

methods.name: extendPluginsConfig
methods.description: Extends CKEDITOR plugin configuration with additional plugins.
